name: infinite-canvas
title: Infinite Canvas
description: Drag (or use arrow keys) to pan an endless wall of tiles that repeats in every direction, with a little momentum when you let go.

meta.useWhen: The Gallery Wall archetype: archives, mood boards, studios with lots of visual work.
meta.avoidWhen: Fewer than ~12 tiles; content that needs order; as the only way to reach the work (also provide a list).
